units.source_text: 他又吟诵白居易的“幼者形不蔽”的诗[\[13\]](#part1335.html#m13)。

en.t: He also recited Bai Juyi's poem about how the young have no clothing to cover their bodies.

units.source_text: 此时他忽然想起了那个瑟缩畏寒、鼻尖发红的小姐的面影，不禁微笑。

en.t: Just then he suddenly remembered the image of the young lady shivering with cold, the tip of her nose red, and could not help smiling.

units.source_text: 他想：“头中将倘使看见了这个人的相貌，不知将如何形容。

en.t: He thought, "If the Captain of the Palace Guards saw this person's appearance, I wonder how he would describe it.

units.source_text: 他常常来这里窥探，也许已经知道我的行为了？”

en.t: He often comes here to spy, so perhaps he already knows what I have been doing."
When he thought of this, he could not help feeling vexed.
